# Anzhu Craft

> > Leading manufacturer of eco-friendly bamboo and wooden disposable tableware, FSC-certified with comprehensive quality and sustainability certifications since 2008.

Anzhu Craft specializes in sustainable bamboo cutlery, wooden tableware, and biodegradable coffee filters. The company maintains rigorous certifications including FSC, BSCI, ISO, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, and SEDEX standards, offering OEM/ODM services for eco-conscious businesses seeking compliant, ethical manufacturing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Bamboo cutlery and tableware
- FSC certification
- Eco-friendly disposable products
- Wooden cutlery manufacturing
- BSCI ethical compliance
- ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards
- BRCGS and FSSC 22000 food safety
- SEDEX SMETA auditing
- Sustainable manufacturing
- Biodegradable tableware
- OEM/ODM services
- Quality assurance standards
- Environmental sustainability
- Bamboo products
- Coffee filters (wood pulp)
